collections.title: ArduPilot tinkering
collections.heading: Micro-AGU: from a small parafoil to autonomous flight.
intro: Start with the flight story: early tests at Barrett Park in Hood River, tuning in a simple simulator, and autonomous missions at Collin’s house in Trout Lake.
Four chapters cover the build, the flights, steering, and longitudinal control. A shared appendix records the evidence; the related Plane trajectory study follows the navigation questions further.

pages.title: From First Tosses to Autonomous Missions
